issues.desc: background.md Key Insights and Trigger Event sections use the term "global-thin" (e.g., "B-4ee0 的 global-thin 只收了 Codex/asset-mode 轴") without defining it inline. A first-time reader unfamiliar with B-4ee0 cannot infer the meaning from context alone. Recommend a one-phrase definition: e.g., "global-thin(全局瘦安装模式)" on first appearance.

background.md references "B-4ee0" as a cross-story reference without a standalone one-sentence explanation of what that story accomplished. CLAUDE.md Dimension 2 convention: cross-story references should have a brief explanation on first appearance. Current text says "B-4ee0 的 global-thin 只收了 Codex/asset-mode 轴" which is partial but does not give a full sentence, e.g., "B-4ee0 (DONE): 收回 Codex/asset-mode 侧到全局 CLI 管理,跳过 LATTICE.md/bin/.Codex 项目写入".

No checklist item has a userSees field. CLAUDE.md requires userSees with precise user-observable output text for each item. Without these, product acceptance at DONE will lack transcript-level done-criteria. Recommend adding userSees to at least CHK-002, CHK-003, CHK-004, and CHK-006 before PLAN.

CHK-004 migration UX is underspecified at the product level: context says provide --upgrade or migration path but does not describe what the user actually sees (command name, confirmation output, error handling for partially migrated state). Acceptable to defer to PLAN, but flag now so PLAN does not skip it.

No item addresses user experience when global symlinks break at subagent invocation time (e.g. after CLI reinstall or npm update). CHK-002 covers sync-time repair, but runtime resolution failure UX (error message? auto-heal?) is not mentioned. Consider adding to CHK-006 smoke scope or as a separate edge case.
